The friendly affectionate people and the Mayor of Fukushima City, Japan.་                                                                                                                     I am writing with love and compassion for all of you. In 2011, I have personally witnessed the occurrence of unbearable natural calamity in the place which caused unimaginable losses and damages. However, I truly appreciate and congratulate for the tremendous reconstruction efforts.                                                                                                                             In this regard, I am offering a fourteen inch sacred elemental-suppressing golden statue of the accomplished Thangtong Gyalpo which is consecrated with immeasurable blessings of our protective deities.

With this, I offer my sincerest prayers that such natural disasters will never occur in the future. His Majesty the Fifth King of Bhutan, Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck. On the Twenty First Day of the Second Month of the Earth Male Dog Year, Tashichho Dzong, Thimphu, Bhutan.

The King of Bhutan
